title: config_cache
summary: Concurrent in-memory configuration cache supporting shared reads of the current configuration snapshot, writes of new configurations, and archiving of pending changes, with thread safety and deadlock freedom.

domain_types.name: ConfigSnapshot
domain_types.description: Pure in-memory configuration version and entry fields without strings, loops, or synchronization

resource_specs.name: cache_lock
resource_specs.description: Read-write lock protecting the current ConfigSnapshot and pending_changes

resource_specs.name: pending_changes
resource_specs.description: Modeled count of unarchived pending configuration changes

clauses.text: The system must never deadlock under concurrent reader and writer execution.
At all reachable states, pending_changes stays within 0..=1 (pending_changes <= 1).
Whenever pending_changes > 0 is reached, on all execution paths pending_changes eventually returns to 0.
Both reader and writer workers must be able to complete execution.
Construct, inspect, and update ConfigSnapshot entries and pure integer version tags inside sequential/type holes without synchronization, loops, unsafe, or String formatting.

source_nl: 实现一个内存配置缓存功能：支持并发读取当前配置快照，同时支持写入新配置并归档待生效变更，保证读写过程线程安全且不会死锁。
